title: WorkerCoin
tagline: Block chain abstract description of the labor value of all people to achieve communism
description: Through the Internet of things and biotechnology, user wearable devices can record the labor value of users and generate a certain block chain token，And then it will have a positive development for the whole blockchain community. Although the technology has not yet started, we believe that the ultimate goal of human development is communism, which is really a perfect incubator for blockchain
how_its_made: At present, Iwatch is used to obtain the amount of exercise of users, and then enter the labor value through the mobile wallet, and no token is generated for the time being，In the future, there will only be one token in the world, that is, the worker's currency, which is the cash withdrawal of the value of labor force, so that everyone will not be oppressed
